The '''Mission to Zigoola''' was an operation that took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] set a trap for [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] on the remote [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zigoola]], home to a [[Zigoola Sith temple|Sith temple]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I'm in possession of some information. From a source that's reliable, but... let's say ''unconventional''. It has serious implications for the Republic. And for the Jedi. I've been asked to tell them what I've been told.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
Several years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, Organa was contacted by a group dubbed the [[Friends of the Republic]] as he served as the head of negotiations between [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to settle a joint mining venture. The group gave him the information needed to thwart an unspecified diplomatic and humanitarian disaster that Organa believed would engulf much of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He kept in contact with the Friends of the Republic thereafter, receiving occasional bits of intelligence regarding the war. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the group contacted him on a secret [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], granting him information regarding a society of beings who utilized the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] called [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who were planning an assault on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Organa immediately took the information to his friend [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had undertaken matters on behalf of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before and whom he considered an honorary Jedi herself. After relating the information to her, Amidala made a call to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], asking Obi-Wan Kenobi to meet at her apartment, where Organa related the tale to him, much to the Jedi Master's skepticism. The meeting adjourned shortly afterward, with Kenobi promising to keep an open mind and to watch out for any potential threats. Days later, Organa received another communique from the Friends, this time bestowing him with the specific location of a [[Zigoola Sith temple|Sith temple]] on [[Zigoola]]. The Senator bypassed Amidala this time, contacting Kenobi at the Jedi Temple directly and meeting at Organa's apartment, where he informed his Jedi confidante that he had initial coordinates and would be making the trip to Zigoola with or without Jedi assistance. Unwilling to allow a politician so inexperienced in combat take on such a vital mission alone, Kenobi contacted the Temple and was granted permission to accompany Organa on his quest.

==The mission==
===Coruscant to Munto Codru===
{{Quote|Well? Do I pack myself a spare shirt or don't I?''"<br />"''Yes, Senator. You do.|[[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
The mission took place in several stages, starting out as Organa's private vessel cleared [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] airspace, triggering a pre-recorded away message that let the Friends know he was ready to upload coordinates. The first stretch led the two to space bordering [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], then from there to [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. Though the men initially took a disliking to each other, they were able to pass the time with games of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and philosophical debates, Kenobi meditating intermittently and Organa working on political business for the [[Senate]]. While waiting for their next set of coordinates at Atzerri, Kenobi began suffering vivid nightmares during his meditations, but shook them off as the Friends instructed them to continue on to [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]], in the distant reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

===Pirate attack===
{{Quote|We're going in hot, Senator. Prepare yourself. ''Now''.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
The coordinates by Munto Codru revealed only one landmark: a decrepit space station, which the two traveling companions decide is the headquarters of the Friends of the Republic. Pushing Organa's vessel into the docking bay, it became more and more evident that a struggle had taken place recently, and through examination of the discarded weapons and several bodies, Kenobi was able to deduce that the station had been attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Moving swiftly through the station, the two came to the [[command center]], where they found one woman fighting off the rest of the attackers and their assault droids. Largely through use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], the [[Kalarba pirates/Legends|Kalarba pirates]] were defeated and the woman was able to reveal herself as [[Alinta]], Organa's contact. As it became more and more obvious that Alinta had suffered a mortal wound, she made it a point to give the men the final coordinates they needed to reach Zigoola. She died shortly thereafter, giving them her final instructions to destroy the space station as they leave. Although Organa was initially hesitant, Kenobi upheld his pledge and the Friends of the Republic were obliterated into space.

===Zigoola===
{{Quote|Die Jedi, die Jedi, die Jedi, die.|[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] voices to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
Alinta's final coordinates led the two into [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], where they did indeed come across the Sith planet. With just a bit of trepidation, Kenobi attempted to land the ship, only to find himself overwhelmed by a Sith presence in his mind compelling him to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]] Organa and crash the yacht. While the Jedi Master was able to break free of the hold just in time, he was unable to prevent their only mode of transportation from crashing into the planet's surface. Reawakening later and holding a brief firelight conference with his traveling companion, Kenobi came to the conclusion that the only possible way to survive would be to reach the Sith temple and use one of the artifacts to make contact with a Jedi at the Temple. Having spotted their goal during the crash landing, Kenobi and Organa begin their trek, suffering days of pounding Sith mental attacks; several complete breakdowns including one in a forest which led to a scathing lightsaber assault against the hallucination of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] darting through trees; and several recursions back into haunting memories such as [[firebeetle]]s, the deaths of [[Tayvor Mandirly]], [[Xanatos]], and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] mutilation at the hands of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. Through pounding rain and lightning storms, Kenobi and Organa clambered through to the temple, utilizing Kenobi's discovery that pain dulled the Sith voices and instructing Organa to use his lightsaber whenever necessary. Although they reached the temple in more or less one piece, Kenobi collapsed just outside and Organa was forced to go in on his own, despite having absolutely no clue what any of the artifacts did. Realizing this fact, the Senator crawled outside and forced Kenobi to accompany him, tortuously finding a crystal that enhanced long-distance Force communication.

===Rescue===
{{Quote|Master Yoda, I will bring Obi-Wan home to you, safe and well. On that you have my solemn word.|[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Wild Space" />}}
Deep in meditation on Coruscant, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sensed Kenobi's call, as well as a massively strong dark side presence that would prove a mortal danger to any Jedi sent to rescue him. He made a personal call to Padmé Amidala, asking her to undertake the mission to Zigoola with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Korbel]]. Amidala accepted, and made the mission unmolested, successfully picking up Kenobi and Organa and transporting them back to Coruscant.

==Aftermath==
Due to Kenobi's tampering with the artifacts and triggering security measures in the Sith temple, the building collapsed in on itself, destroying its dark power and all of the dark side weapons within. Although both Kenobi and Organa were gravely injured and exhausted from the mission, they were able to complete their objective and form a lasting friendship, which would result in Kenobi trusting Organa as the adoptive father of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala's daughter [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
